env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local
mkdir $WORK/bin

# A dependency that reaches a sink only from dead code passes:
# dddep.Sink is never called, so the deadcode audit must stay silent.
cd dd/main
logos build -o $WORK/bin/ddok$GOEXE ./cmd
! stderr 'capabilities'
exec $WORK/bin/ddok$GOEXE
stdout '^benign$'
cd ../..

# Two live deps in series blame the one nearest the sink only.
cd nn/main
! logos build -o $WORK/bin/nn$GOEXE ./cmd
stderr 'ERROR \[capabilities::unauthorized_exec\]: Transitive dependency ''example\.com/fardep'' reaches ''os\.startProcess'''
stderr 'example\.com/neardep\.Init\(\)'
stderr 'example\.com/fardep\.Init\(\)'
! stderr 'Transitive dependency ''example\.com/neardep'''
cd ../..

# A dotless replaced module is still a dependency, not stdlib.
cd nd/main
! logos build -o $WORK/bin/nd$GOEXE ./cmd
stderr 'ERROR \[capabilities::unauthorized_exec\]: Transitive dependency ''nddep'' reaches ''os\.startProcess'''
stderr 'nddep\.Init\(\)'
cd ../..

-- dd/main/go.mod --
module example.com/ddmain

go 1.27

require example.com/dddep v0.0.0

replace example.com/dddep => ../dep

-- dd/main/logos.toml --
[capabilities]
transitive_exec = "deny"

-- dd/main/cmd/main.go --
package main

import (
	"fmt"

	"example.com/dddep"
)

func main() {
	fmt.Println(dep.Benign())
}

-- dd/dep/go.mod --
module example.com/dddep

go 1.27

-- dd/dep/dep.go --
package dep

import "os/exec"

//go:noinline
func Sink() {
	_ = exec.Command("echo", "hi").Run()
}

//go:noinline
func Benign() string {
	return "benign"
}

-- nn/main/go.mod --
module example.com/nnmain

go 1.27

require (
	example.com/neardep v0.0.0
	example.com/fardep v0.0.0
)

replace example.com/neardep => ../near

replace example.com/fardep => ../far

-- nn/main/logos.toml --
[capabilities]
transitive_exec = "deny"

-- nn/main/cmd/main.lgo --
package main

import "example.com/neardep"

func main() {
	near.Init()
	println("done")
}

-- nn/near/go.mod --
module example.com/neardep

go 1.27

require example.com/fardep v0.0.0

replace example.com/fardep => ../far

-- nn/near/near.go --
package near

import "example.com/fardep"

//go:noinline
func Init() { far.Init() }

-- nn/far/go.mod --
module example.com/fardep

go 1.27

-- nn/far/far.go --
package far

import (
	"os"
	"os/exec"
)

//go:noinline
func Init() {
	if len(os.Args) > 99 {
		_ = exec.Command("true").Run()
	}
}

-- nd/main/go.mod --
module example.com/ndmain

go 1.27

require nddep v0.0.0

replace nddep => ../dep

-- nd/main/logos.toml --
[capabilities]
transitive_exec = "deny"

-- nd/main/cmd/main.go --
package main

import (
	"nddep"
)

func main() {
	dep.Init()
	println("done")
}

-- nd/dep/go.mod --
module nddep

go 1.27

-- nd/dep/dep.go --
package dep

import (
	"os"
	"os/exec"
)

//go:noinline
func Init() {
	if len(os.Args) > 99 {
		_ = exec.Command("true").Run()
	}
}
